info.title: Bulk Screenshot API - Capture Up to 50 URLs in a Single Request
info.description: Capture screenshots of multiple websites in a single POST request. Accepts up to 50 URLs per request with per-URL options for file type, viewport size, blocking, caching, and scrolling capture. Returns a status indicator, metadata with success/failure counts, and an array of per-URL results — each containing either screenshot data or an error message. Also supports stealth mode, GPU rendering, classic and premium proxies with country selection, timezone emulation, text captcha solving, and PDF options for paper size, orientation, page range, media type and backgrounds. A simple screenshot costs 50 credits. Options add credits on top: scrolling or video +20, classic proxy +20, premium proxy +200 (used instead of a classic proxy), GPU rendering +20, captcha solver +20. Stealth, timezone and the other options add no credits.

post.summary: Capture screenshots of multiple websites in a single request.
post.description:
Our Bulk Screenshot API allows you to capture screenshots of multiple webpages simultaneously, saving you time and effort. Instead of manually capturing each page one by one, you can batch process URLs and receive high-quality screenshots in the format you choose.
 Maximum `50 URLs` per request.

200.description: Successful response. Each item in `results` corresponds to one requested URL, in the same order; a URL that fails validation or capture returns an error object in its `url` field instead of screenshot data, while `status` stays "fulfilled" and `error_message` stays null.

url.message: Your URL is incorrect

perUrlCaptureErrors.summary: Each URL in the batch fails with a different per-URL capture error. The same error codes the single Website Screenshot API can return for a target URL show up here inside each item's `url` field, while the overall response stays 200/success.

The url parameter is required but was not provided.
The file_type value is not a supported output format.
The proxy value is malformed or invalid.
The latitude or longitude value is outside the allowed range.
The css_url value is not a valid URL.
The js_url value is not a valid URL.
The JavaScript passed in js is invalid and could not be executed.
The clip[x], clip[y], clip[width] or clip[height] values are invalid.
A parameter that expects an integer received an invalid value.
A secure connection could not be established because of an SSL certificate problem on the target site.
The SSL certificate does not match the domain. The site may be down or may have moved.
HTML, Markdown or text extraction is not supported.
PNG, JPG and WEBP are not supported for scrolling capture. Use a video format such as MP4, WEBM or GIF.
The request was aborted before it completed, for example due to a timeout or cancellation.
A tunnel connection to the target could not be established. Check the URL and proxy setting.
A tunnel to the target failed. Verify the URL and proxy settings.
The target site unexpectedly closed the connection.
The target server closed the connection without returning any data.
The browser and the target website have incompatible SSL/TLS versions or ciphers.
The request could not be completed due to temporary unavailability, such as a closed browser. Retry the request.
The target page may be temporarily down or may have moved permanently.

BulkScreenshotSuccessItem.description: Per-URL result entry. The `url` field holds either the screenshot metadata or an error object, depending on whether that specific URL was captured successfully.

status.description: Processing status of the individual URL. Usually `fulfilled`.

url.description: Screenshot metadata for this URL, or an error object if this specific URL could not be captured.

oneOf.description: Screenshot metadata with the same structure as the single Website Screenshot API response.
Per-item error returned when this specific URL cannot be captured.

error_message.description: Error message if processing failed, null if successful.

BulkScreenshotRequest.description: Request body for bulk screenshot capture.

urls.description: Array of URL objects to capture. Maximum 50 items per request.

BulkScreenshotUrlItem.description: A single URL entry in a bulk screenshot request with per-URL options.

url.description: URL of the website to be rendered as a screenshot or other format.

file_type.description: Output format. PNG (lossless, transparency), JPEG (compressed, smaller size), WebP (modern, efficient), PDF (document). For scrolling captures: MP4, GIF, WebM. Scrolling capture formats: WEBM (web-optimized), MP4 (widely compatible, default), GIF (short loops).

image_quality.description: Compression level for JPEG output (0-100). Lower = smaller file, higher = better quality. Only applies to JPEG.

omit_background.description: Replaces simple white/plain backgrounds with transparency for a cut-out effect. Only works with PNG output.

pdf_options.description: PDF output options. Applies when file_type is PDF.

format.description: Paper size of the PDF. Applies when file_type is PDF. Without it, width and height are used if set, otherwise the page renders as one long page: A0, A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, Letter, Legal, Tabloid, or Ledger.

landscape.description: Renders the PDF in landscape orientation, swapping the width and height of the paper size. Applies when file_type is PDF.

page_range.description: Pages to keep in the PDF, as start-end, for example 1-3 or 5-5. Pages are rendered first and then trimmed. Has no effect on a single-page PDF. Applies when file_type is PDF.

media.description: CSS media type used to render the PDF: print or screen.

print_background.description: Includes background colors and images in the PDF. Applies when file_type is PDF.

result_file_name.description: Custom name for the output file. Helps with organized storage and retrieval. Note: non-unique names may overwrite existing files.

ttl.description: Time in seconds the render stays cached before auto-invalidation. Use higher values for static pages, lower for dynamic content. Default: 2592000 (30 days).

fresh.description: If `true`, bypasses cache and captures a fresh render. If `false`, returns cached version when available.

enable_caching.description: Stores the render in cache for reuse on subsequent identical requests.

destroy_screenshot.description: If `true`, screenshot/PDF is not stored on server and must be downloaded immediately.

fail_on_error.description: If `true`, returns an error when the target page responds with 4xx or 5xx status.

width.description: Viewport width in pixels. Simulates device screen sizes. Max: 7680.

height.description: Viewport height in pixels. Controls how much vertical area is visible. Max: 4320.

full_page.description: Captures the entire webpage from top to bottom, including scrollable content outside the viewport. Ideal for long-form pages.

thumbnail_width.description: Specifies the width of the thumbnail in pixels. Default value is 0 (meaning no specific value is set, and the screenshot is returned at its original resolution).

retina.description: Captures at 2x resolution for sharper, high-DPI output. Increases file size.

clip[x].description: X coordinate (in pixels) for the top-left corner of the clip area. Default: null.

clip[y].description: Y coordinate (in pixels) for the top-left corner of the clip area. Default: null.

clip[width].description: Width of the clip area in pixels. Default: null.

clip[height].description: Height of the clip area in pixels. Default: null.

adjust_top.description: Initial vertical scroll position in pixels before capture. Use to position mid-page content in viewport. Not supported for PDF.

wait_for_event.description: Controls when rendering starts based on the page load lifecycle. `load` waits for all resources, `domcontentloaded` waits for the HTML to be parsed, `networkidle0` waits until there are no network requests for 500ms, and `networkidle2` waits until no more than 2 requests are active for 500ms. Use `networkidle2` when a page keeps one or two long-running requests open, such as a polling call, that stop `networkidle0` from completing. Write the value in lowercase, exactly as listed.

delay.description: Wait period in milliseconds before capture. Allows animations, API responses, and dynamic elements to finish rendering. A value above 30000 is cut to 30 seconds and the request still succeeds.

lazy_load.description: Automatically scrolls the page to trigger lazy-loaded images and components. Ensures complete content capture.

scroll_delay.description: Delay in milliseconds between scroll steps when `lazy_load` is enabled. Use higher values for heavy pages. On a long page, a very high value can push the total time past `timeout` and fail the request.

timeout.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds for page load before aborting. Adjust for slow/heavy pages. Default: 100000 (100s).

selector.description: CSS selector to capture a specific element. Only that element is rendered. Falls back to full page if not found. Default: empty.

scroll_to_element.description: Scrolls the page to bring the specified CSS selector into view before capture. Ideal for below-the-fold content. Default: empty.

selector_to_click.description: CSS selector for an element to click before capturing the screenshot. Useful for opening dropdowns, modals, or triggering content.

click_recursion.description: Number of times to click the selector (when set via `selector_to_click`).

blur_selector.description: CSS selectors to blur before capture. Masks sensitive data like emails, payments, or personal info. Multiple selectors supported. Default: empty.

remove_selector.description: CSS selectors to remove before capture. Deletes matched elements from DOM. Ideal for cleaning ads, popups, sidebars. Multiple selectors supported. Default: empty.

css.description: Allows injecting custom CSS code into the page before rendering. Pass the CSS code directly as a string.

css_url.description: Allows loading external CSS into the page. Provide a URL pointing to the CSS file.

js.description: Allows injecting custom JavaScript code into the page before rendering. Pass the JavaScript code directly as a string.

js_url.description: Allows loading external JavaScript into the page. Provide a URL pointing to the script file.

custom_html.description: Custom HTML to render instead of loading a URL. Overrides the url option. Use for capturing specific HTML structures or dynamic content.

markdown.description: Markdown to render instead of loading a URL. Works like custom_html, so you can capture a README or notes without hosting a page.

user_agent.description: Custom User-Agent string sent in the request headers.

accept_languages.description: Sets the accepted languages for the HTTP request. This is sent as the Accept-Language header.

dark_mode.description: When set to `true`, websites that support prefers-color-scheme: dark will render in dark mode.

grayscale.description: Applies a grayscale filter to the screenshot. Requires a value from 0 (no effect) to 100 (fully grayscale).

enable_incognito.description: Enables private/incognito browsing. Each render starts with a clean slate - no cookies, cache, or session data persisted.

headers.description: Custom HTTP headers to include as key=value pairs. Use a semicolon to separate multiple headers (e.g., `key1=value1;key2=value2`).

cookies.description: Cookies to include in the request before rendering. Supports single or multiple cookies. Example: `cookie=value; otherCookie=otherValue;`.

longitude.description: Specify longitude for the browser Geolocation API. Provide a numeric value. Default: null (not set).

latitude.description: Specify latitude for the browser Geolocation API. Provide a numeric value. Default: null (not set).

timezone.description: IANA timezone the browser uses while rendering, such as Asia/Karachi or Europe/London. Useful for clocks and localized dates.

block_ads.description: Blocks requests to known ad networks for cleaner, distraction-free screenshots.

block_chat_widgets.description: Blocks live chat popups, support bubbles, and messaging interfaces.

block_tracking.description: Blocks tracking scripts and analytics services for cleaner, privacy-oriented renders.

no_cookie_banners.description: Hides or blocks cookie consent banners and popups before capture.

block_js.description: Disables all JavaScript execution. Renders a static version of the page. Speeds up capture but may break dynamic content.

block_stylesheets.description: Blocks all stylesheets - page renders as raw HTML without visual formatting.

block_images.description: Blocks all image resources (jpg, png, gif, webp, svg, etc.) for faster rendering.

block_media.description: Blocks audio and video resources (mp3, mp4, webm, etc.) from loading.

block_font.description: Blocks external font files - page falls back to system defaults. Supported: woff, woff2, ttf, otf, eot.

block_text_track.description: Blocks subtitles and caption overlays from loading.

block_xhr.description: Blocks all XMLHttpRequest (AJAX) calls - prevents dynamic API-driven content.

block_fetch.description: Blocks all Fetch API requests - stops async data loading.

block_event_source.description: Blocks EventSource (SSE) connections - prevents real-time data streams.

block_web_socket.description: Blocks WebSocket connections - prevents real-time bidirectional communication.

block_manifest.description: Blocks manifest files (.json, .webmanifest) - disables PWA-related functionality.

block_specific_requests.description: Blocks specific requests. Separate rules by comma, space, or newline. A rule without `*` must match the full request URL exactly, including the scheme and path; a bare domain or partial path does not match. A rule with `*` is a wildcard: each `*` matches any run of characters, including dots and slashes, the whole URL must match, and matching is not case-sensitive. Use wildcards for URLs that change on every load, such as a random subdomain or port, for example `https://*.example.com:*/*`. Default: empty.

extract_text.description: Strips all HTML and returns visible text as a .txt file. Ideal for text analysis, indexing, or AI pipelines. Only with output=json.

extract_html.description: Returns rendered HTML as a .html file (includes JS-executed DOM). Only available with output=json.

extract_markdown.description: Extracts rendered page content as a structured .md (Markdown) file. Preserves headings, lists, links. Only with output=json.

get_image_urls.description: Extracts all image URLs from the rendered DOM and returns them in structured format. Only with output=json.

stealth.description: Makes the browser look like a regular visitor for pages that block automated traffic. No extra credits.

gpu.description: Renders the page with a GPU, including WebGL and canvas content. Adds 20 credits per request.

proxy.description: Allows defining a proxy for the connection. Provide a JSON string with keys: server (include port number), username, and password.

classic_proxy.description: Loads the page through a datacenter proxy. Adds 20 credits per request. Ignored when premium_proxy is true or a custom proxy is set.

premium_proxy.description: Loads the page through a residential proxy. Adds 200 credits per request. Used instead of classic_proxy.

country.description: Two-letter country code, such as US or DE, for the exit address of classic_proxy or premium_proxy. Ignored when you send your own proxy. Any two-letter code is sent, including one that is not listed. Classic proxy countries: BG, GE, DE, HN, MD, UA, GB, US. solve_captcha.description: Solves a captcha made of text drawn in a picture, then takes the screenshot. Requires captcha_image and captcha_input. It reads text inside a picture only; checkbox challenges and challenges that ask you to select pictures are not supported. Adds 20 credits per request.

captcha_image.description: CSS selector of the captcha picture, for example `#captcha-img`. Required when solve_captcha is true. The solver waits up to 30 seconds for it to appear.

captcha_input.description: CSS selector of the box the answer is typed into. Required when solve_captcha is true.

captcha_submit.description: CSS selector of the button to click after the answer is typed. Without it the answer is typed but no button is pressed, which works only when the page checks the answer as you type.

captcha_error.description: CSS selector of the message shown for a wrong answer. While it is visible, the solver tries again. Without it the solver cannot tell that a guess was wrong and makes one try.

captcha_refresh.description: CSS selector of the control that loads a new captcha picture before the next try.

captcha_retries.description: Number of guesses the solver makes, from 1 to 5. When every guess is rejected, the request fails.

ocr_model.description: Recognition model used by the captcha solver: mini-ocr-v1 (default) or ocr-v1.

scrolling_screenshot.description: Enables scrolling screenshot mode to capture a video (webm, gif, mp4) of the webpage.

scroll_speed.description: Scrolling speed: fast, normal (default), or slow. Affects render time and output pacing.

duration.description: Duration of scrolling action in seconds (0-60). Higher = longer video. Default: null (full page scroll).

scroll_back.description: If `true`, scrolls to bottom then back to top, creating a seamless loop.

start_immediately.description: Starts recording immediately without waiting for full page load.

video.description: Records visible viewport only for a specified duration. Use with `duration` parameter. Ideal for dashboards and animations.

output.description: Set the output format. `json` returns metadata with a hosted file URL. `image` streams the raw file bytes directly.

BulkScreenshotMetaData.description: Metadata about the bulk screenshot request results.

total_urls.description: Total number of URLs processed in the bulk request.

successful_urls.description: Number of URLs that were successfully processed.

failed_urls.description: Number of URLs that failed to process.

BulkScreenshotResponse.description: Bulk screenshot response containing status, metadata, and per-URL results.

status.description: API request status indicator. `success` for successful requests.

BulkScreenshotResults.description: Array of per-URL results, one entry per requested URL, in the same order as the request. Each entry's `url` field holds either screenshot data or an error object.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by the API on failed requests.

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.

X-AF-Credits-Cost.description: Specifies the number of credits consumed by the current request.

X-Concurrent-Threads.description: Specifies the maximum number of concurrent requests allowed.

X-Concurrent-Threads-Active.description: Indicates the number of active concurrent requests being processed.
